about.heading: Who We Are
about.sub: Professional Expertise Supporting Your Financial Growth
about.body: N Accounts & Tax Consultancy is a team of experienced professionals dedicated to providing expert tax and accounting services across India. We are committed to accuracy, compliance, and maximising the financial benefits available to every client.
about.our_story:
N Accounts & Tax Consultancy is a professional tax and accounting consultancy firm based in Thiruchengodu, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. We provide end-to-end financial compliance and business registration services to individuals and businesses across India.

Built on the principles of accuracy, transparency, and a client-first approach, we combine professional expertise with a fully online delivery model — so you receive expert guidance wherever you are in India.
about.founder_specialisation: Tax Filing, GST Compliance, Business Registration, Accounting
about.founder_bio: Nikunn S holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree with a specialisation in Professional Accounting. With in-depth expertise in Indian taxation, GST compliance, and business registrations, Nikunn brings precision and dedication to every client engagement — ensuring the right outcome, the first time.
about.reach_body: Our office is based in Thiruchengodu, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu — but our services reach every corner of India. Thanks to our fully online delivery model, no physical visit is ever required. From the initial consultation to final document delivery, everything is handled securely online.
